summary: Eps 1-70 (1998 TV, AniList 232) adapt the 50-chapter original manga (AniList 30106): the Clow Card arc (eps 1-46) covers vol 1-6 / ch 1-26 with the anime interleaving 33 anime-original card episodes (already typed filler in our rows; animefillerlist agrees exactly) and freely reordering the 19 manga captures (Shadow/Thunder pulled into eps 2/8, Shield/Mirror/Mizuki shuffled across eps 11/25/26, Firey (ch 23) done at Christmas before the play/Light-Dark (ch 20-21) in eps 41-42); the Sakura Card arc (eps 47-70) covers vol 7-12 / ch 27-50 fairly linearly except ch 36 (ep 52) landing before ch 33-35 and ep 70's rewritten ending (Nameless card instead of the hand-sewn bear/epilogue). Ep 71 is NOT the Sealed Card movie our component says: it is the Clear Card Prologue OVA 'Sakura and the Two Bears' (AniList 98554), a faithful adaptation of original ch 46-50 that ends on Clear Card ch 1's opening - so the existing ep93->50 anchor belongs on ep 71. Clear Card begins at ep 72 (CC ep 1 = CC ch 1-3) and eps 72-93 loosely adapt Clear Card manga ch 1-24 (vol 1-5; AniList 87296, a separate 80-chapter manga) with six anime-original episodes (76, 83-87, Meiling/anime-only cards) and an anime-original finale that rewrites ch 24. 35 original-numbering anchors (eps 1-71, 31 canon episodes + the OVA) plus 16 Clear Card anchors are provided; 4 type corrections on the 1998 series and 7 on Clear Card.

anchors.note: Ch 1 opens in medias res (Sakura already has Windy/Wood/Jump; the Clow Book opening is a flashback); Fly is captured in ch 2 (manga uses Wood+Jump, anime uses Windy).

Watery; manga sets it in the school pool (Chiharu nearly drowns), anime at the aquarium.

Syaoran's transfer, compass, fight with Touya = ch 8; the Thunder capture is ch 10 (grafted in).
Rika buys the sword brooch while shopping for Yukito's birthday gift (ch 8 tail); possessed Rika / Sword captured, Illusion used to distract her (ch 9).
Sports day, Sonomi vs Fujitaka race, Flower captured (ch 6-7); in the manga this precedes Syaoran's arrival and ends with him sensing the cards.
Tomoyo's mansion, Sonomi's memories of Nadeshiko, Shield captured (ch 13). Pulled forward: manga has Mizuki's intro (11) and Mirror (12) first.
Summer visit to great-grandfather Masaki Amamiya's house; rainbow made with Rain in the anime, Watery in the manga (ch 19).
Class trip test of courage / cave, Erase captured (ch 17). Manga has Mizuki already introduced and Syaoran walking on water instead of Float.
Tsukimine summer festival with Yukito, fireflies, Glow captured (ch 18); Touya and Syaoran compete to give Yukito plushies.
Doppelganger Sakura / Mirror captured (ch 12; the double first appears at the very end of ch 11). Manga places this right after Mizuki's introduction.
Kaho Mizuki introduced as the new teacher (ch 11) + the Maze (ch 14-15, Maze captured ch 15 with Mizuki's bell). Anime adds Meiling.
Christmas date / Firey captured (ch 23); in the manga Kero regains his true form right after Firey (anime waits for Earthy).

Card (Sand) is anime-only; the school-play casting (Sakura as prince, Syaoran as princess) is the manga's lead-in to the ch 21 blackout. Ch 20's cast list (whole class + Terada + Mizuki, no cards) fits, but ch 20 has no prose synopsis - inferred.
School festival play blackout, Light and Dark captured (ch 21).
Kero's private conversation with Mizuki (Kero suspects she is Yue) = ch 22 per Wikipedia's vol 5 summary; the archery tournament framing is anime-original.
Earthy (appears end of ch 23, captured ch 24 with Wood); Yue revealed at the chapter's end.
Final Judgment vs Yue, Mizuki's Moon Bell, staff transformation, Clow Reed apparition, Mizuki departs (ch 25-26). Anime adds Syaoran to the judgment.
Eriol and Nakuru transfer in; localized downpour, Sakura cannot use her cards (ch 27, Watery fails against the cyclone).
Star-power incantation; Firey is the first card transformed (fandom infobox: ch 28; the same page's prose says ch 29 - flagged).
Aftermath: Sakura collapses from the transformation, Kero explains the toll, cards named 'Sakura Cards' (ch 29 per cast/card gallery and Wikipedia vol 7). Piano/Song incident is anime-original.
Invisible threads control Syaoran; Sword transformed (ch 30). Eriol/Spinel/Ruby Moon reveal to the viewer closes vol 7.
Teddy-bear legend (Yamazaki/Chiharu, ch 31) and the giant bear; Jump and Fly transformed, new winged form (ch 32).
Hole in the playground, sheep plushies, Yue's weakening; Erase transformed (ch 36; manga also transforms Earthy here). Anime placed this before ch 33-35.
Nadeshiko's calendar / Flower transformed (ch 34) and the reconciliation with great-grandfather Masaki (ch 35).
Yue confronts Eriol and has his memory erased; Syaoran's near-confession (ch 37); warped school, Shadow transformed (ch 38).
Yukito fading, Touya gives his power to Yue - the end of ch 38 (ch 39 opens with Sakura having overheard them). Film-shoot framing is anime-original.
Sakura confesses to Yukito at the school festival (ch 39); Maze+Illusion planetarium, Sakura finds Eriol and faints, vision of Clow's death (ch 40).
Tsukimine shrine festival (yukata gift in manga, scarf in anime; ch 41); magical horse, Wood/Thunder/Glow transformed (ch 42).
Return-card trip to Clow's past is anime-only; ch 43 covers the same beats (premonitory dream of Clow, Kero, Yue; Tokyo Tower plan; Eriol-Fujitaka resemblance; Mizuki's letter). Loose.

Tokyo Tower / eternal-night spell, Shield-Watery-Light-Dark transformed with Kero and Yue's power (ch 44); Fujitaka reveal and Eriol halving his power (ch 45, manga-only); Mizuki's role, Eriol's explanation, Syaoran's confession (ch 46).

Eriol leaves for England (ch 47); Syaoran's departure (ch 48-50) heavily rewritten: anime has the Nameless card and Syaoran giving Sakura his bear at the airport; manga has Sakura sewing him a bear and a two-years-later epilogue.

Prologue OVA 'Sakura and the Two Bears' (AniList 98554): a faithful adaptation of the manga's ending (Eriol's departure, Syaoran's confession, the hand-made bear, the bus, the two-years-later reunion) and it closes on the opening scene of Clear Card ch 1.

structure.notes: Confirmed: component 1 = AniList 232, 70 eps (S1 eps 1-35 'Clow Card' pt1, S2 36-46 pt2, S3 47-70 'Sakura Card'), adapts original manga 30106 (50 ch, 12 vols; Clow arc = vol 1-6/ch 1-26, Sakura arc = vol 7-12/ch 27-50). Component 3 = AniList 97881, 22 eps (2018-01-07..06-10) = our eps 72-93, adapts the SEPARATE Clear Card manga (AniList 87296, 80 ch/16 vols) loosely through ch 24 (vol 5) with an anime-original ending; Clear Card starts at our ep 72 (CC ch 1). COMPONENT 2 IS MISLABELED: it carries AniList 372 (Movie 2: The Sealed Card, 2000, anime-original) but row 71's title/date ('Sakura and the Two Bears', 2017-09-13) is the Clear Card Prologue OVA, AniList 98554 (MAL 35320), bundled with Clear Card manga vol 3 - it adapts original ch 46-50 (the manga's ending) and closes on Clear Card ch 1's opening scene. Fix component 2 to 98554 [ova] and treat 372 (and Movie 1, 371) as order-only anime-original films. Cumulative numbering 1-70 / 71 / 72-93 is otherwise consistent with animefillerlist's 93-ep list. The context file's volume boundaries are a corrupted merge of the two manga by volume number (v12: 46-59 = orig v12 46-50 + CC v12 55-59; v13-v16 are Clear Card volumes) - the CC chapters there are in CC numbering, not offset. AniList 163326 'Clear Card-hen (Zoku-hen)' (sequel adapting the rest of the manga, announced Sakura Fes 2023) is still NOT_YET_RELEASED, so 93 aired episodes is currently complete. Note also that Clear Card TV follows the 1998 anime / Sealed Card continuity (Meiling exists, Sakura got Syaoran's bear), not the manga/OVA - so the OVA is optional in an anime-continuity watch order.
